metadata.name: Federal funds target rate and range changes since 1990
metadata.description: Every change to the FOMC's target for the federal funds rate on the Federal Reserve Board's list, from July 1990 on: the date as printed by the Board, the direction and size of the change, and the level after it (a single target rate before December 16, 2008, a range after). A change that FedRateCalc has recorded from an FOMC statement but the Board's list does not show yet is added and labelled. Each row names its source and the date it was checked.

sources.label: Federal Reserve Board, Open Market Operations page
Federal Reserve Board, Open Market Operations Archive page
Federal Reserve Board: FOMC meeting calendars and information

columns.name: date
columns.meaning: The date printed on the Board's list (YYYY-MM-DD), or the FOMC statement date for a row labelled fomc-record.

columns.name: change_bps
columns.meaning: Signed change in basis points (negative for a decrease); empty when the Board prints a span (75-100 on 2008-12-16).

columns.name: change_bps_as_printed
columns.meaning: The change exactly as the source prints it, in basis points.

columns.name: target_type
columns.meaning: single for a single target rate (before December 16, 2008), range for a target range.

columns.name: target_lower_pct
columns.meaning: Lower end of the target range, in percent; equal to the target for a single rate.

columns.name: target_upper_pct
columns.meaning: Upper end of the target range, in percent; equal to the target for a single rate.

columns.name: level_as_printed
columns.meaning: The level exactly as the source prints it, in percent (for example 3.75-4.00).

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: openmarket (Board page, 2003 on), openmarket-archive (Board archive page, 1990-2002) or fomc-record (FedRateCalc record of the FOMC statement).

columns.name: source_url
columns.meaning: The page the row comes from.

columns.name: source_checked
columns.meaning: The date the Board pages were checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: note
columns.meaning: The Board's footnote for the row, when it has one.

rows.note: On July 10, 2024, this date was corrected from March 3, 2020, to March 4, 2020.
